quote.text: Do not say of anything “I have lost it,” but rather, “I have given it back.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • View every challenge with your children not as a loss, but as an opportunity to share wisdom and resilience; by returning what no longer serves, you pave the way for growth.
    • Embrace setbacks as moments to teach the value of letting go gracefully, demonstrating that sometimes giving something back nurtures new beginnings and deeper bonds.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that relinquishing control isn’t defeat but an act of empowerment—by giving back authority, you promote a culture of responsibility and trust.
    • Understand that what appears as a loss can instead be reframed as a strategic transfer of energy, enabling both yourself and your team to evolve and innovate.
  • Product Management
    • See product adjustments not as failures but as deliberate choices to return outdated ideas, making space for innovation and responsiveness to customer needs.
    • Adopt a mindset where each cycle of iteration is a gift to users, continuously refining products with thoughtful feedback and strategic evolution.
